Nadia, Gideon landed on **280 seats** for Vantorre Group in his July 1 update in #strategic-pod.

He first said 300. A few minutes later he corrected it: "please ignore that earlier number—it is 280". The 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from their May rollout. 280 is the active seat count on the production roster as of July 1. Ruth acknowledged the 280 figure in the same thread.

That's the July figure, so it may have changed since.
